result:
I've revised all 29 team-03 pages to the live home theme. Nothing was regenerated or verified in a browser. Every value comes from reading the CSS, so the visual checks are yours: the body's computed background and DM Sans, DM Serif on headings, and the 393 px and 1440 px layouts.

**Applied to every page**
- **Theme link:** `../assets/site-theme.css` is now the last item in `<head>` on all 29 pages, after `studio.css` and each page's own styles. I didn't edit that shared file.
- **studio.css:** rewritten so its old color, font and line tokens now point at the shared home tokens. Blue-grey, teal and system-font styling in the inline page styles inherits the paper, warm-white, charcoal and green palette with DM Sans and DM Serif without editing each rule.
- **Controls:** primary buttons are green, secondary buttons are warm white with a fine line, pressed toggles are charcoal (as in the home filters), and panels are flat 22 px cards with the home's near-invisible shadow.
- **Header:** the plain "← Alford Daily" text link is now a small back arrow, the brand logo and the "Alford Daily" wordmark, with "Daily" in green. On very narrow phones (under 350 px) only the logo shows.
- **Headings:** the small all-caps label headings and the heavy system-font clue and category text are now sentence-case DM Serif. I removed every bold weight applied to DM Serif, because it has no bold face and would render as fake bold.
- **Removed materials:** the blue trays and docks, the navy window in Trail D, glossy gradient pebbles and keys, the dark category bar in Quadra B, and long drop shadows. Game pieces stay tactile but flat.

**Game colors that changed or were deliberately kept**
- **Kept:** Sprout's plant stays green, Memory Maze's route and walls are unchanged, Trail's selection states are unchanged, and misses and knots now use the home's clay red.
- **Tic-Tac-Toe:** your × was royal blue and is now charcoal; the AI's ○ is green. They differ in lightness as well as symbol.
- **Tangle:** the three thread colors now come from the home page's collection emblems (teal-green, violet, ochre) instead of slate and blue.
- **Sprout pots and the Sprout D planter** are a pale clay, applied only to those objects.

**Text wrapping**
- Small labels that shared a row with other text are smaller and allowed to wrap.
- Rows of action buttons now size to their labels, so long ones like "Check · 6 to go" don't overflow.
- The Quadra C and Tumbler toggles never wrap mid-label.

I also fixed an existing bug in Split D where the clue font size applied to the small "LEFT · WORD 1" labels.

**Unwired controls:** the old notes said all prototype buttons show a "prototype" message. That's wrong for these, which do nothing when pressed:
- the "?" help button and the back link on every page;
- "Reveal solution…" on Trail A, Trail D, Quadra A, Memory Maze A and Dovetail A;
- the hint buttons in Quadra A and D;
- "Reveal a letter" in Dovetail A;
- Sprout's "Undo growth", "Restart" and "Which letter?";
- "Show a safe splice" in Splice and "Loose end hint" in Tangle.

`NOTES.md` now carries this correction.

**Other files**
- `game-proposals.json`: I updated the descriptions that still mentioned old styling (Trail D, Quadra B, Tangle, Tumbler, Tic-Tac-Toe). All keys and file references are unchanged.
- `REVISION-02.md`: new, with the per-game changes, color decisions and the full unwired-control list.
- `NOTES.md`: points to the revision and corrects the outdated font and recommendation statements.

On phones, the on-screen keyboards in Keystone and Tumbler now sit in a padded tray, so their keys are about 1–2 px narrower than before.

Files are in `team-03/`:
- `REVISION-02.md`
- `NOTES.md`
- `game-proposals.json`
- `studio.css`
- the 29 concept pages
